safety_verdicts.content: Patient is taking the Clenil inhaler every day, 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated confirms Clenil daily (section-018) but does not include the Gold dosing detail of 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the baseline Clenil dose (2 puffs BID) reduces the clinician’s ability to gauge control and the magnitude of any step-up in inhaled steroid dosing during this exacerbation. This could lead to suboptimal titration or monitoring, but is unlikely to directly cause serious harm in the short term.
